source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.3.1.1 (PDF 212-213), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Qualitative Research (baaton aur raye wali research): is research ka maqsad customers ki andar ki wajah (reasons), raye aur motivations (kisi kaam par ubharne wali wajah) samajhna hai. Is mein non-numerical (jo numbers mein na ho) data jama hota hai, maslan interviews, focus groups aur observation (dekh kar note karna) se.

Misal: agar aap bakery khol rahe hain to qualitative research mein potential customers (jo customer ban sakte hain) se detail mein baat cheet hogi ke unhein kis qisam ki bread aur pastries pasand hain. Is se pata chalta hai ke customers sab se zyada kis cheez ki qadr karte hain, aur isi se aap tay kar sakte hain ke kya bechna hai aur marketing mein kya paigham dena hai.

Quantitative Research (numbers aur ginti wali research): qualitative ke ulat is mein numerical (numbers wala) data jama hota hai jise naapa ja sake aur statistics (numbers ka hisab) se jaancha ja sake. Yeh customers ke behavior (khareedne ke tareeqe) mein patterns (baar baar dohraye jane wale andaaz) aur trends (log kis taraf ja rahe hain) pehchanne mein kaam aati hai.

Misal: survey se maloom kiya ja sakta hai ke log kitni baar coffee khareedte hain aur us ke liye kitne paise dene ko tayyar hain. Yeh maloomat qeemat tay karne aur aane wali sales ka andaza lagane mein madad deti hai.

blocks.prompt: 200 logon se poochna 'Cupcake ke liye kitne paise denge?' qualitative research hai ya quantitative?
blocks.explanation: Quantitative, kyunke is se numbers milte hain jin ka average (ausat) nikala ja sakta hai aur muqabla kiya ja sakta hai.

items: Qualitative: 'kyun' samajhna (interviews, baat cheet). Quantitative: 'kitna, kitni baar' ginna (surveys).
